neighbours.label: The word 'practice' in 'in practice' (as opposed to in theory or on paper)
fire: The law requires a warrant to search private property; however, in practice police often ignored it.
The constitution protects free speech, but in practice journalists were routinely detained.
Workers must be paid overtime by law; in practice overtime was extended beyond the legal limit.
In theory the system is fair, yet in practice judges rarely questioned the prosecutors.
The plan looked good on paper, but in practice the trains were late every single day.
Detainees are entitled to counsel; however, in practice they were not always allowed to see one.
The rule allows appeals, though in practice few people ever succeed in having a decision changed.
The policy promises equal pay, but in practice women in the department earned less than men.
